description: OPTIONAL. Renovate needs an installed app or a self-hosted runner; this repository is
fully functional without it, and .github/dependabot.yml covers everything declared in a
manifest. Renovate is here for exactly one thing Dependabot cannot do: track a version
string in an arbitrary file. See docs/watchlist.yaml for what is tracked and why, and
docs/lifecycle.md section 6 for the three-mechanism split.
Note the naming history: this feature was `regexManagers` and is now `customManagers`
with customType 'regex'. Older examples on the web use the retired key.

customManagers.description: Versions recorded in docs/watchlist.yaml that no manifest of ours declares.
